correctness.rationale: The product of a commuting idempotent tuple yields a common fixed point, making all maps linearly representable around that point. Boolean orthogonal idempotents classify each linear tuple, and the quotient of common centers by the full-ones eigenspace supplies the exact affine multiplicity and stabilizer. Dimension sums give every product rank. Taking q^d² from |GL_d(q)| leaves a fixed-lattice Gaussian tilt; a uniform Euler-product lower bound and dominated convergence rigorously yield total variation. The checker independently reproduces complete small rank profiles.

value.rationale: The finite affine transformation monoid and its compositions are natural objects. The all-k joint rank enumerator specifies complete conjugacy orbits and fibers, with a nontrivial translation weighting that changes the balanced-rank limiting distribution. This provides an infinite-family arithmetic invariant and asymptotic law, not merely a short numerical list or restatement of classical simultaneous diagonalization.
